## Houston v0.6.8

- Routines now show the model they will use and its connection health, with a direct way to reconnect.
- AI model setup is smoother, with Azure OpenAI connections through your endpoint and more reliable Amazon Bedrock setup.
- Attachments that changed or disappeared now show clear instructions to attach them again.
- On Windows, file dialogs no longer open a black console window and voice typing is more reliable.
- Stability and polish improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS does not always replace an app that is running.
